mapper.sql: select b.batch_id, b.med_id, b.supplier_id, b.batch_no, b.produce_date, b.expire_date, b.batch_qty, b.remain_qty, b.purchase_price, b.in_time, b.batch_status, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, m.med_code, m.med_name, m.med_spec, m.unit, m.warn_days, s.supplier_name, to_days(b.expire_date) - to_days(curdate()) as remain_days from med_stock_batch b left join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id left join med_supplier s on s.supplier_id = b.supplier_id
mapper.insert:
insert into med_stock_batch
med_id, supplier_id, batch_no, produce_date, expire_date, batch_qty, remain_qty, purchase_price, in_time, batch_status, create_by, remark, create_time
#{medId}, #{supplierId}, #{batchNo}, #{produceDate}, #{expireDate}, #{batchQty}, #{remainQty}, #{purchasePrice}, #{inTime}, #{batchStatus}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate()
mapper.update: update med_stock_batch set remain_qty = greatest(ifnull(remain_qty, 0) + #{changeQty}, 0), update_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId}

update med_stock_batch b left join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id set b.batch_status = case when ifnull(b.remain_qty, 0) <= 0 then '3' when b.expire_date < curdate() then '2' when b.expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval ifnull(m.warn_days, 90) day) then '1' else '0' end, b.update_time = sysdate() where b.batch_status != '3' or ifnull(b.remain_qty, 0) <= 0
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from med_stock_batch where batch_status = '1') as nearCount, (select count(1) from med_stock_batch where batch_status = '2') as expiredCount, (select ifnull(sum(remain_qty), 0) from med_stock_batch where batch_status = '1') as nearQty, (select ifnull(sum(remain_qty), 0) from med_stock_batch where batch_status = '2') as expiredQty, (select ifnull(sum(remain_qty), 0) from med_stock_batch where batch_status in ('0', '1')) as normalQty
